info.name: Nextdoor Midnight Summer - Moonlit Glass
info.description:
Requires Nextdoor webpage settings to be set to Dark Mode. 

Transform Nextdoor into a serene summer night with deep midnight blues, luminous cyan accents, subtle violet highlights, and beautifully translucent glass panels.

A moonlit bokeh backdrop creates a cool, atmospheric setting while preserving the familiar Nextdoor experience. Navigation menus, news feeds, Local Faves, marketplace listings, notifications, and chats share a cohesive glassmorphism aesthetic.

Featuring soft backdrop blur, refined borders, coordinated icons, and carefully balanced contrast, Midnight Summer brings a calm, elegant after-dark atmosphere to your neighborhood.
